def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # strip whitespace / fix label variants (island has ' Biscoe')
    for col in ['island', 'species', 'sex']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    # body_mass_g is text with commas and out-of-range value 3625000
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
        # fix out_of_range: 3625000 -> 3625 (divide by 1000 if > max 6500)
        mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
        df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
        # if still out of range after division, coerce to NaN
        df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # ensure flipper_length_mm numeric (sample shows as text)
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # drop exact duplicate rows (profile: 1 duplicate)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # drop missing sex (missing means unknown; do not guess)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    # drop missing body_mass_g if any after cleaning
    df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
    grouped = df.groupby('sex', dropna=True)['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
